system.description:
The Opal Mages Guild Association (O.M.G.A.) trains illusionists to serve Opal as spies, interrogators and propagandists.

  • Reshapes: your Eye for the False and Disguise.
  • Perfect Impersonation: Advantage on Disguise checks to impersonate a specific person.
  • Interrogator's Edge: a creature that fails a Will save against one of your Enchantment or Illusion spells has Disadvantage on its next Will save against you this encounter.
    • 9th level: on its next two Will saves against you.
  • State Authority: Advantage on Charisma checks that invoke the authority of a state or order you serve, and on long-term social infiltration.
